# ARCH-23: A new parameter has to earn its flash, and a feature costing 1 KB or more sits behind its own define

Every parameter is paid for on every board that carries its code - 16 bytes of table plus its name in flash on a 32-bit board, a longer download at every ground station connect, and one more setting a user has to understand. Add one only when a constant, a default worked out automatically, an existing parameter or a bit in an existing `_OPTIONS` bitmask cannot carry the choice, and prefer the option bit. A feature that costs about 1 KB or more on a 1 MB board goes behind its own enable define ([ARCH-4](ARCH-4.md)) with its parameters inside the same guard, off by default unless most users of the vehicles that build it need it, and the PR states its flash cost and the parameters it adds. peterbarker, [#12810](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/pull/12810): "We shouldn't really add too many parameters if there is a sensible default"; [#34543](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/pull/34543)'s EKF lane OSD items, about 1 KB with optical flow, compile out upstream and are on only in the SFD fork.

Confirmed 2026-11-02. Part of the root playbook, under [Architectural Principles](../claude/CLAUDE.md#architectural-principles). [All architectural rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
